Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
ALTEN Romania, part of the international ALTEN Group - with a unique position as a Leader in IT and engineering Consulting - has supported its clients’ development strategies in innovation, R&D, and IT systems since 1996.
 We are looking for a talented Salesforce Developer to analyze business requirements and deliver innovative Salesforce solutions, including Apex development, triggers, and integrations with external systems.
 💡Responsibilities:
Analyze business requirements and define the most effective implementation approach.
Develop and maintain custom solutions within the Salesforce platform.
Design and implement integrations between Salesforce and the company’s core systems or external partner systems.
Develop Apex classes, triggers, and automation processes.
Create and maintain technical documentation for developed code and processes.
Collaborate with business and technical teams to ensure high-quality solution delivery.
 📋Requirements:
Minimum 2 years of experience as a Salesforce Developer.
Proven experience implementing Apex classes and Salesforce triggers.
Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using SOAP/REST web services and APIs.
Experience developing complex business processes using Process Builder.
Experience creating custom user interfaces with Visualforce.
At least 1 year of active involvement in medium to large-scale Salesforce projects.
Strong knowledge of XML, JavaScript, and SQL.
Advanced knowledge of Visualforce and Apex.
Experience developing custom Salesforce components is considered a strong advantage.
 📂Preferred Qualifications:
1+ year of hands-on experience working with SOAP web services.
1+ year of experience working with SQL.
2+ years of hands-on experience with Salesforce.com.
 🚀 Only eligible candidates will be contacted in a maximum of 2 weeks. Any information you provide is confidential.
